title: Investigation pickup: the time window of the run
description: How to use context.window in the pickup request. The server adds it when the client advertised investigation_window_v1 in protocol_capabilities. The window was stored when the run was created, so it does not change while the run works. The field is left out for a client without the capability and for a run made before windows. The same field is in GET /api/v1/investigations/{id}/context.

x-fields.from: Start of the window, an RFC 3339 time.
x-fields.to: End of the window. Left out means until the run ends: the incident is still open, so use now.
x-fields.basis: Where the window came from: first_signal_moment or first_signal_ongoing (Tellagen proposed it from the incident), person (a person set it) or follow_up (copied from the run this one corrects).
x-fields.baseline_from: Start of the baseline, which ends where the window starts. Left out means the run has no baseline.
x-fields.first_signal_at: When the first signal of the incident came in. Left out when none is known.

x-time-text: A time with no zone in a request, such as 2026-11-14 00:11, is read as UTC. Send RFC 3339 times to be exact.
x-guidance: Search for the cause inside the window: every query that looks for what went wrong uses a range between from and to.
Use the baseline only to learn whether a number is normal, for example the error count of the same hour on earlier days. Never look for the cause in it.

When the signal starts before from or after to, do not search outside the window. Send window_suggestion with the result and say so in a finding. window_suggestion is {from, to, reason}: the same limits as a window, a reason of at most 200 characters, and to may be left out for an open incident.

The server warns evidence_outside_window when a cited source has a time range that reaches outside the window and its baseline together. It is advice, not an error. A count over the baseline does not trigger it.
A window never sets or proposes a root cause. A person accepts a root cause.

good_suggestion.reason: The first 502s are at 22:14, 2 hours before the window starts.
